## `environment.yml` file ![](images/conda2.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} ## `environment.yml` file with package versions listed The python script is here: [GitHub repo: append_version_to_environment_yml](https://github.com/skysheng7/append_version_to_environment_yml.git) ![](images/conda3.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} ## Conda-lock ![](images/conda4.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} # 🧐 Why do we need Conda-lock? ::: {style="font-size: 0.8em;"} * Conda-lock solves the dependency for all platforms (Linux, Windows, MacOS) * [Here is a conda tree](https://github.com/skysheng7/DSCI_522-001-slides/blob/main/support_files/tree.pdf) showing how Conda solves dependencies for a simple conda environment. * Below is the code I used to generate the conda tree: ::: ```{bash} #| eval: false conda activate myenv conda install -c conda-forge graphviz conda-tree conda-tree deptree --dot > file.dot dot -Tpdf file.dot -o tree.pdf ``` ## Docker ![](images/conda5.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} ## Docker Container ![](images/container.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} ## Virtual Machine vs. Container ![](images/vm_docker_compare.png){style="margin-bottom: 0px;"} ::: {style="position: absolute; bottom: 10px; right: 20px; font-size: 0.5em;"} Source: [eG innovations](https://www.eginnovations.com/blog/containers-vs-vms/) :::
